arStrings.szText: Whenever you kill a {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemy, {c_important}Doom{/c} spreads the {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} to another enemy and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_DAMAGE}{/c} damage to them.
{c_important}Doom{/c} is cast at range on the ground, leaving behind a mark that Tethers your Primary Target and {c_important}{u}Hexes{/u}{/c} enemies within for {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Doom{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and your {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} is applied with Maximum Stacks for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds but you can only have one {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} target at a time. When {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} expires or is removed, {c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE}{/c} damage split amongst all enemies in the area.
{c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to enemies for each second they have been {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Doom{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} Wrath every {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds for each {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemy.

Casting {c_important}Doom{/c} against a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}, or Slowed enemy assimilates the effects, causing {c_important}Doom{/c} to also apply those effects for {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Doom{/c} echoes {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} of its damage to all Nearby {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies.
